hook: Telangana farmers keep picking *veggies over paddy*.
hook_b: Telangana farmers keep picking *veggies over paddy*.
tldr: Telangana farmers' shift from paddy to vegetables and spices continues in Yasangi 2026, driven by water savings and market demand.

beats.what: The Hindu: farmers continue preferring vegetables and spices over paddy in Yasangi 2026.
beats.why: Water savings, market demand and drought-resistant seeds are behind the shift.
beats.care: The Horticulture Director says high heat in the next few months may cut produce by around 20%, which may drive demand.

effects.label: Veg prices at risk from heat

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu quotes Horticulture Director Shaik Yasmeen Basha: heat may reduce horticulture produce by about 20%, which may drive demand.

cards.q: More farms grow vegetables, less paddy. What do you want?

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Telangana farmers' preference for veggies, spices over paddy continues in Yasangi 2026

insight: Heat may cut produce about 20%, which may push demand up.
